name: Signal
description: Deep navy institutional presentation master with warm bone-paper alternates, muted-gold accents, editorial serif headlines, and high-density report frames.

font_strategy.cjk_display: Noto Serif SC or Microsoft YaHei
font_strategy.cjk_body: Noto Sans SC or Microsoft YaHei

readability_scale.target: classroom projection readable at approximately 3 meters

render_strategy.notes: Each slide uses a high-fidelity PNG rendered from the source HTML template as the background, with editable text boxes overlaid from DOM text-node coordinates. Overlay text is transparent to avoid double-rendering over the screenshot background. The build script forces animated elements into their final visible state and enlarges small labels/body text for classroom projection.

rescue_notes: Rebuilt as an HTML-background hybrid master following the same interface standard as blue_professional. Frontend and Writer consume visual_master=signal.
